handbookNote: Louisiana 'Class D & E Driver's Guide', Louisiana Office of Motor Vehicles (DPSMV2052, cover-dated R08/25) -- fetched directly from the official OMV portal on 2026-08-16: expresslane.la.gov/omv/resources/driver-manuals/ links to the official PDF hosted at public.powerdms.com/LADPSC/documents/347039 (PowerDMS-Public-Document header confirms PDF, DocumentId 347039), downloaded and text-extracted with pdftotext -- full text saved to temp/handbooks/la/driver.txt (about 6,270 lines / 138 pages covering licensing, GDL, signs/signals/markings, safety belts, defensive driving, following/stopping distance, traffic laws, interstate/rural driving, hazards/emergencies, DUI, chauffeur/Class D basics, and registration). Real exam mechanics CONFIRMED from two independent official Louisiana OMV sources, not guessed: (1) the driver's guide itself (Chapter 1, Driver's License Tests) states the knowledge test is computer-based multiple choice and requires correctly answering 80 percent of questions to pass; (2) the OMV's own official Learner's Permit page (expresslane.la.gov/omv/drivers/personal-driver-s-licenses/permits/) states plainly: 'Applicants must pass a vision test and have 20/40 vision in one eye and also pass a 40 question test with a minimum score of 80%.' So the confirmed mechanics are: 40 questions, 80% passing score (32 of 40 correct), computer-administered. No official Louisiana source states a time limit for the knowledge test, so timed/untimed is left unconfirmed rather than invented. Content depth: this is an unusually rich, detailed 138-page guide with specific cited numbers throughout (GDL hour/age requirements, BAC limits and DWI penalty schedule, following-distance rules, stopping-distance figures, school-bus and railroad-crossing stop distances, parking-restriction distances, bicycle 3-foot passing law, cell phone/texting statute, seat belt and child-restraint law by age, and more) -- comfortably supporting 276 distinct, non-repetitive, grounded questions across 20 topic files without padding. Chauffeur-only Class D commercial content (air brakes, cargo/trailer size limits) was deliberately excluded from the question bank as out of scope for the standard Class E passenger knowledge test that this track targets. Every question is grounded in a specific cited passage of the fetched official guide text or the official OMV permits FAQ page; none are invented or generic 'common knowledge' items. Price matches this project's established Driver tier ($4.99), not a placeholder.
